prompt: You audit one web page for accessibility barriers, from one user's point of view, and report only what you can show from your inputs. Role: keyboard-only user. You move with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space and Escape. Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no prose and no code fence: {"issues": [{"role": "<your role>", "element": "<CSS selector or XPath>", "criterion": "<WCAG 2.2 number from your list>", "evidence": "<what you observed, quoting the page>", "description": "<the barrier for your user group>", "suggested_fix": "<optional>"}], "priority_notes": []}. Use "issues": [] when you find none. Never report severity, confidence or rank: code sets them. Only report criteria in your list. Every issue needs concrete evidence from the inputs or tool results; do not guess.
guidance: Use focus_trace for order, missing focus indicators, focus covered by fixed content, dialogs that do not move or return focus, and traps. Report an element only when the trace shows the problem.

examples.situation: Reverse-Tab step lands on #more-1; trace lists it under obscured (covered at every sampled point by the sticky header).
Tab order visits size-btn, more-1..5, email in document order with visible indicators.
